text:
ANTI-MONEY LAUNDERING DIRECTORATE FICTIONAL REGULATOR - SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE
Bulletin: Sanctions list updates
Notice number: RCN-2026-021
Issued by: Anti-Money Laundering Directorate
Published: 2026-11-09
Effective date: 2026-12-15
1. Who this applies to
All firms subject to sanctions screening obligations.
2. Background
Sanctions designations now change more often. Screening must catch up quickly.
3. Requirements
3.1 A firm must screen its customer base against each update to the sanctions list within 24 hours of the update being published.
4. Status
Firms must comply with the requirements in section 3 from 2026-12-15.

obligations.text: A firm must screen its customer base against each update to the sanctions list within 24 hours of the update being published.
obligations.controlDesc: Rescreening job runs automatically within 24 hours of each sanctions list update, with completion logged
obligations.reason: Policy POL-AML-03 states "When a sanctions list is updated, the full customer base is rescreened within 24 hours of publication" and Control CTL-165 confirms "Rescreening job runs automatically within 24 hours of each sanctions list update, with completion logged", both matching the obligation's 24-hour requirement exactly.
